name: npm-run-chain
description: Made-up project for js-prueffactory tests: the test script chains two npm scripts, each a Mocha run with its own config under test/config (built in code, no .mocharc) and its own setup file under test/setup, with mocha-multi-reporters as the reporter and c8 used only in a CI shell script (ci/test.sh). One test in the api layer fails.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
